title: ci-scope reads the guard's import closure from its one home, not a copy
why: Coordinator 13:05 CST Nov 8, found by lane lint-config-guard-paths (session_013NEJL1f9CA1PTZPYsRhFQV, #2205): .github/scripts/ci-scope.sh keeps its own copy of guard.py's import list. Its janitor/* arm has no guard flag, so a janitor/sweep.py edit skips test_guard and the guard mutation test. Fix: ci-scope reads merge/merge.py guard_import_closure (added in #2205) instead of a copy (rule building-allow-list-is-the-constant). Merge after #2205.
